verdict.rationale: The pack has no statement of an open-source license or any license terms for LiteLLM's code. A GitHub repo URL and a self-hosted proxy hint that the source may be public, but they do not show that it is readable under an open license. The only license mention is an enterprise commercial license ('Multi-region deployment under one license'), which is a different matter.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
